faqItems.title: How does ClickUp support the five project phases?
faqItems.markdown: ClickUp aligns naturally with each phase of the [project management life cycle](https://clickup.com/blog/project-management-life-cycle/). You can define scope with Whiteboards and Docs, plan timelines in Gantt views, execute tasks via List or Board views, monitor KPIs with Dashboards, and wrap up projects smoothly in Docs. The Project Management Hub covers each step clearly.

faqItems.title: Can I easily switch between Agile, Waterfall, and Kanban in ClickUp?
faqItems.markdown: Yes, ClickUp adapts easily to popular [project management methodologies](https://clickup.com/blog/project-management-methodologies). Run Agile sprints using Board view, manage structured Waterfall timelines with Gantt charts, or visualize workflows using Kanban boards. If your methodology shifts, just switch your view or apply a fresh template. The Hub helps you decide and transition.

faqItems.title: How does ClickUp compare to other project management tools?
faqItems.markdown: ClickUp separates itself from [other project management tools](https://clickup.com/blog/best-project-management-tools) like Asana, Trello, Jira, Notion, and Slack by combining tasks, docs, chat, dashboards, and automation in one platform. It is more configurable, supports multiple project views, and reduces context switching with AI for planning, updates, and reporting.

faqItems.title: Does ClickUp have AI agents for project management?
faqItems.markdown: Yes. ClickUp offers a library of [AI agents for project management](https://clickup.com/brain/agents/templates/project-management/) that handle sprint planning, resource allocation, standup facilitation, risk assessment, and project documentation. You can browse and activate them directly from your workspace.
